evidence.detail: declaration, requirements block, parameter list read mechanically from the page

parameters.description: Pointer to the format name string of the queue you want to open. The format name must be in the private direct format. See the Remarks section for restrictions on the different types of format names.
parameters.name: lpwcsFormatName

parameters.description: Specifies how the application accesses the queue (peek, send, or receive). This setting cannot be changed while the queue is open. Specify one of the access modes listed in the following table. Value Description MQ_PEEK_ACCESS Messages can only be looked at. They cannot be removed from the queue. MQ_SEND_ACCESS Messages can only be sent to the queue. MQ_RECEIVE_ACCESS Messages can be looked at and removed from the queue. Whether a message is removed from the queue or looked at depends on the dwAction parameter of MQReceiveMessage .

documented_values.description: Messages can only be looked at. They cannot be removed from the queue.
Messages can only be sent to the queue.
Messages can be looked at and removed from the queue. Whether a message is removed from the queue or looked at depends on the dwAction parameter of MQReceiveMessage .

parameters.name: dwAccess

parameters.description: How the queue will be shared. Specify one of the values listed in the following table. Value Description MQ_DENY_NONE Default. The queue is available to everyone. This setting must be used if dwAccess is set to MQ_SEND_ACCESS. MQ_DENY_RECEIVE_SHARE Limits those who can receive messages from the queue to this process. If the queue is already opened for receiving messages by another process, this call fails and returns MQ_ERROR_SHARING_VIOLATION. Applicable only when dwAccess is set to MQ_RECEIVE_ACCESS or MQ_PEEK_ACCESS.
